annotation.authors_or_issuer: The White House (President of the United States)
key_provisions_or_claims: Policy of sustaining US global AI dominance via a minimally burdensome national framework
DOJ AI Litigation Task Force to challenge inconsistent State AI laws within 30 days
Commerce to publish evaluation of onerous State AI laws within 90 days
BEAD non-deployment funds and discretionary grants conditioned on States not enacting conflicting AI laws
FCC to consider federal reporting/disclosure standard and FTC policy statement to preempt State laws; legislative recommendation excluding child safety, data centers, State procurement
annotation.summary_en: Executive Order 14365 sets a US policy of a minimally burdensome national AI framework and seeks to curb State AI laws. It creates a DOJ AI Litigation Task Force, orders Commerce to evaluate State laws, conditions federal funding, directs FCC and FTC preemption steps, and requests a preemptive legislative recommendation.
annotation.title_clean: Executive Order 14365: Ensuring a National Policy Framework for Artificial Intelligence
annotation.title_en: Executive Order 14365: Ensuring a National Policy Framework for Artificial Intelligence
